preflight.why: Verify the LIVE rendered DOM — schema (+ who emits it), resolved alt, breadcrumb. External curl is often WAF-blocked; the loopback probe is the reliable verify path.
Never duplicate queued work. Context compaction drops pending IDs, so re-query before queueing.

preflight.do: page_robustness_audit + win_audit before building/optimizing, and again after
preflight.why: Clear the three-layer standard (intent -> conversion -> trust) and beat competitors. Anchor every YMYL claim to a .gov/.edu/medical source.

pending_queue.what: ALL writes queue as pending changes for human approval; nothing publishes itself.

gsc_warehouse.what: Full-fidelity local GSC archive (SQLite on operator machine); instant SQL, no pruning. Sync at session start for GSC work.

outcome_engine.what: Did an applied edit WORK? Difference-in-differences verdicts (win/flat/regressed) + leads; cite did_delta_pct, never raw totals.

revert_loop.what: Queue a snapshot-restore of a regressed edit as a normal pending change.

lead_events.what: Daily Elementor Pro form-submission counts per page — the money metric; auto-folded into outcome_report.

attention_system.what: Pages are eye-paths, not section stacks: archetype spec BEFORE composing, predicted-heatmap audit AFTER (flat_hierarchy = generic-page smell).

widget_schema.what: Live Elementor control registry — NEVER guess setting keys (typos are silent no-ops); queue validates with did-you-mean. v0.80: containers/sections/columns included; every Elementor write is validated on EFFECTIVE values (new > stored > default) with inert_setting / global_token_overrides_literal / defaults_in_effect warnings; widget_schema(post_id, widget_id) shows stored vs effective vs applies for one element. An absent key is a DEFAULT, not unset.

operator_kit.what: Site stores design skills + bootstrap bundle; a fresh machine rebuilds the whole environment from the site.

operator_brain.what: The site stores the WHOLE operator brain (every memory file + index, every skill, CLAUDE.md, secrets-stripped .mcp.json template) AND the bridge bin/ files. whoami on every site tells every laptop whether it is behind (operator_brain.status) and whether its bridge matches (operator_brain.bridge.status), and pushes relevant_rules (HARD/STRICT + site-specific memories) into the first call. A second laptop must never again open a chat with missing tools or unknown rules: pull, restart, continue.
operator_brain.tools: operator_brain_status, operator_brain_push, operator_brain_pull; CLI bin/brain-sync.php (status|push|pull|bootstrap across every site in .mcp.json)

builders.what: Native Elementor composition (recipes, containers, service pages, spec builds) + Divi surgical module edits, including removing a leftover module from a Theme Builder layout without opening the builder (v0.70).

audit_family.what: Three-layer page standard (intent/conversion/trust) + competitor beating + design/a11y/schema checks; run before AND after builds.

seo_playbook.what: Bundled 2026 SEO doctrine (universal + industry overlay), served in whoami top_rules.

clarity_heatmaps.what: Opt-in Microsoft Clarity tracker (settings) validates attention_audit predictions against real behavior.

session_gate.what: v0.81: HARD by default. Any write is REFUSED (409 session_not_bootstrapped) until whoami ran on this site within 8h. update_site_memory_notes (Sessions) is REFUSED (409 open_loops_unacknowledged) while working_state is active with open_loops, unless acknowledge_open_loops=true (loops are then appended to the note). recent_pending carries post-apply `verification` verdicts. The per-chat half is the Claude Code hook .claude/hooks/cc_gate.py (deny writes before whoami in THIS session; deny render-affecting edits before render_probe/page_facts on that post; block Stop while notes lag mutations >20 min; auto-push the operator brain).

version_drift.what: whoami warns when this site runs an older plugin than the local build, and (v0.79) when the LOCAL bridge is older than the site — the "functions are missing" case — with the exact pull to run.

commodity_router.what: Every top page classified INVEST / BRIDGE / CITE_PLAY / STOP from CTR-vs-position absorption + intent + info-gain elements; new drafts warn on zero non-commodity signals.

aeo_tracking.what: Weekly AI-visibility snapshot: absorbed-query census + AI-crawler hits + AI Overview presence, trended in the warehouse.

rank_math_schema.what: Edit Rank Math Schema Builder rows in place by dot path (offers.price etc). The ONLY path to those capitalised postmeta arrays — draft_update_postmeta lowercases the key and flattens the array. %variable% placeholders survive.

stack_introspection.what: STOP GUESSING AT WP-ADMIN. Enumerate every installed plugin (not just the curated list site_memory sniffs), read the REAL admin menu tree with clickable URLs, and read a plugin's current settings with credentials redacted. The menu is a snapshot captured during admin page loads because third-party plugins register admin_menu only when is_admin() is true, so it cannot be rebuilt from REST.

asset_references.what: Find and swap a media URL WHEREVER it is stored — post_content of any post type, postmeta, options, termmeta — searching every spelling (JSON-escaped, protocol-relative, root-relative, http twin). This is the way into plugins that keep content outside post_content and have no dedicated tool: popup overlays, sliders, theme option backgrounds. Serialized values are unserialized/rewritten/re-serialized so length prefixes stay valid; rows holding non-stdClass objects are refused, not risked. media_audit finds the heavy files worth swapping.

render_health_guard.what: Does the page still WORK after a change? Queue captures a rendered-page baseline (empty-state strings, markup-anchored element counts, shortcode leakage, PHP errors, HTTP status); the post-apply audit re-fetches cache-busted and compares. A builder empty-state appearing or an element population vanishing is flagged CRITICAL on the pending row + activity log + dashboard within ~30s of apply. Reports only; never auto-reverts. Companion lint change: failures are split into introduced-by-this-change vs pre_existing-in-current-body, and pre-existing structural failures no longer hard-block unrelated edits.
render_health_guard.tools: (automatic on queue + apply; see lint introduced/pre_existing in queue responses)

setting_writes.what: CHANGE the setting of another plugin, draft-queued — the write half of get_plugin_settings. One leaf of one option by dot path, any plugin, no per-plugin adapters. Refuses core options, credential-shaped keys, non-scalar values, and paths that do not already exist (a typo would otherwise store a key the plugin never reads, so the setting looks changed while doing nothing). Revert restores the whole option, not just the leaf. Writing a setting is NOT proof it took effect: free-tier plugins can save fields only their Pro code honours, so always re-measure the real output.

bulk_term_tagging.what: Assign ONE taxonomy term to MANY posts in a single approval. Solves the two ways wp-admin gets this wrong: its category filter misses products sitting in deeper sub-terms, and its product search matches DESCRIPTIONS so accessories that merely mention a brand get tagged. Matching is title_contains (SQL LIKE on post_title only), in_term (a term AND all its children), or explicit post_ids. Returns a plan with matched / already-tagged / will-change counts before anything is queued; rollback restores the exact prior terms on every post, including posts that had none. Products are eligible here even though they are off-limits to body edits, because term relationships cannot corrupt product content or pricing.

workflows.gsc_analysis: gsc_warehouse_sync -> gsc_warehouse_query (SQL aggregates, never raw dumps) -> outcome_report for applied-edit verdicts.
workflows.page_build: attention_spec(post_id) -> widget_schema for any unverified setting -> compose -> attention_audit + render_probe + page_robustness_audit -> queue.
workflows.page_optimize: render_probe BEFORE -> warehouse queries for the page's tokens -> edit -> render_probe AFTER -> outcome_report in 28d.
workflows.weekly_harvest: Per site: striking-distance, CTR-leak, and momentum SQL sweeps on the warehouse -> top 3 actions -> queue.
workflows.bad_outcome: outcome_report verdict=regressed -> verify on page -> propose_revert(edit_id) with the numbers as reasoning.
workflows.new_machine: Fresh laptop: fetch bin/ from GET /operator-kit/bridge -> php bin/brain-sync.php bootstrap --url --user --pass (pulls memory + skills + CLAUDE.md, writes .mcp.json) -> whoami must show operator_brain.status=in_sync and bridge.status=in_sync -> gsc_warehouse_sync. Existing laptop that whoami calls behind: operator_brain_pull (memory/skills) or operator_brain_pull(what=bridge) + MCP restart. After editing memory/skills anywhere: php bin/brain-sync.php push.
workflows.fix_schema: render_probe (who emits what) -> get_rank_math_schema(post_id) for exact dot paths -> draft_update_rank_math_schema -> approve -> render_probe AFTER. Never add a second emitter for a field Rank Math already owns.
workflows.edit_the_unreachable: A plugin owns content no tool can edit (popup image, slider banner, theme background)? Do NOT ask for a per-plugin adapter. find_asset_references(current_url) to see every row that stores it -> replace_asset_reference(old_url, new_url) -> approve. If the content is text rather than a URL, get_plugin_settings(slug) first to find where it lives.
workflows.image_weight: media_audit (heaviest on disk + which uploads WordPress re-encoded LARGER than the original) -> find_asset_references on the worst offenders to see which pages load them -> replace_asset_reference with a properly sized file. Resize to at most big_image_size_threshold BEFORE uploading; WordPress leaves those files untouched.
workflows.bulk_product_tagging: Hundreds of products need a brand/term? Do NOT hand-click wp-admin. list_product_categories or the taxonomy REST route to confirm the term EXISTS (this tool never creates terms) -> draft_bulk_assign_term(dry_run=true) to see matched/already/will-change -> check the sample titles are the right slice -> queue -> approve. Re-run per brand; 600 targets max per plan.
workflows.find_a_setting: NEVER guess a wp-admin path. list_installed_plugins (confirm it is actually installed and get the slug) -> stack_admin_menu (the real menu tree with the exact clickable URL) -> get_plugin_settings(slug) (what it is currently set to). If stack_admin_menu returns available=false, ask the operator to open any wp-admin screen once so the tree can be captured, rather than guessing the path.

capabilities.hint: This manifest is generated by the plugin version you are talking to — trust it over memory. Full doctrine: tool descriptions + seo_playbook + design skills (operator_kit).

industry.label: Healthcare (clinic, ER, hospital, dental, vet, pharmacy)

top_rules: INTENT DOCTRINE (one page = one intent): service/landing pages serve the CONVERSION intent and must NOT chase informational queries. Business mode flips above-the-fold: EMERGENCY ER = transactional/local (click-to-call + Walk In 24/7 + address/directions, EmergencyService schema) vs SCHEDULED wellness/clinic = commercial/transactional (Book a Consultation, MedicalClinic schema). Informational "what/why/causes/symptoms/when to go" content belongs on a blog SPOKE that links inline to the service page. Run page_robustness_audit(post_id) before AND after every build/optimize; run win_audit against same-intent competitors only.

YMYL Health classifier applies (Google pre-classifies healthcare pages on a stricter standard). Every service page names the provider + credential (MD, DO, FNP-C, APRN, PA, DDS, DVM, PharmD) inline AND in schema Person, with sameAs pointing to LinkedIn / NPI / state license registry / specialty board.

Schema by facility type: clinics use MedicalClinic; urgent care uses MedicalClinic or MedicalBusiness; freestanding emergency rooms use EmergencyService; hospitals use Hospital; dental uses Dentist; vet uses VeterinaryCare; pharmacy uses Pharmacy. Service pages add MedicalProcedure + Person + FAQPage. Never ship two FAQPage entries on the same URL.

Authority density: minimum 1 .gov / .edu citation per 1000 words. Trusted hosts: NIH MedlinePlus, CDC, NIDDK, FDA, NEJM, JAMA, Mayo Clinic. For pediatrics: AAP. For emergency medicine: ACEP, ENA. For dental: ADA. For veterinary: AVMA.
Reviewed-by pattern: "Medically Reviewed by: NAME, CREDENTIAL | Updated: MONTH YEAR" visible on every clinical page (or "Reviewed by:" for dental/vet/pharmacy where "medically reviewed" reads odd).
ER and urgent-care pages lead with triage decisioning. Question-shaped H2s like "When is this an ER visit vs urgent care?" outperform service-description H2s on emergency-intent queries.
Meta title: 50-60 chars. Lead with the primary entity + modifier the page already pulls impressions on. Audit GSC queries BEFORE rewriting; never drop a token the page ranks for.
Meta description: 120-160 chars. Lead with the primary entity, name a trust signal, name a concrete differentiator, end with a CTA.
H1: exactly one per page. The hero H2 is the canonical H1 on Elementor pages without a theme-rendered title.
Featured-snippet H2s: question-shaped headings need 40-60 word answers in the same section. Outside that window, Google ignores the snippet eligibility.
AI Overview structure: concrete + cited. One named source per claim. Direct opening sentence (definitive answer in first 1-2 sentences) lifts AI citation +14% across 7 sectors (Indig).

AIO CTR-loss is real: 47-65% lower clicks at position 1 when an AI Overview is present (Ahrefs, Seer, Authoritas, Indig). Run aio_ctr_drop_alert before assuming a low-CTR page needs a title rewrite; brand-impression value is the right frame for AIO-prone queries.

Site-wide quality (March 2026 reweighting): one thin section drags the whole domain. Helpful-content signal aggregates page-level scores into a host-level embedding (matches the leak's siteAuthority / siteFocusScore / hostNsr). Rewrite or remove thin clusters; do not just bury them.
Fan-out coverage matters more than schema for AI Mode: pages ranking for the primary query + at least 1 fan-out query produce 51% of citations, primary-only under 20% (Search Engine Land study).

Foundational SEO drives AI citation: no special markup, no llms.txt, no content chunking, no AI-specific rewrites (Google 2026-05-15 guide, Ahrefs 1,885-page A/B test: schema-for-AI showed -4.6% AIO citations).
NavBoost reality (DOJ-confirmed): clicks, dwell, pogo-stick are 13-month rolling re-rank signals. Engagement on existing rankings outranks chasing new ones.
Internal links: weave inline. NEVER append "Related guides" / "Read more" blocks. Anchor text is the keyword the destination owns.
Cannibalization: each page must own its primary keyword. Two pages competing at the same intent dilute both.

ONE OWNER PER QUERY (measured 2026-08): Google offered 33 URLs from a single site for its head local query and none held the top three; another site had 9 own URLs on "medical weight loss irving" with the owner capped at position 10 despite a perfect title. Self-competition is invisible on per-page reports because each page looks merely mediocre. Run site_status: self_competition names google_prefers (the natural owner) and zero_click_rivals (deindex/merge those first). Then register the owner with keyword_targets so the fix is tracked.

ABSORBED vs CITED have IDENTICAL symptoms (high impressions, no clicks) and OPPOSITE meanings. Absorbed = an AI Overview answered above you (position 2.4, zero clicks): stop chasing CTR, reformat to be the cited source. Cited = machine fan-out queries (long sentences, or naming Cleveland Clinic / AHA / AAD) rank you at position 1-8 with zero clicks: that is a WIN, an AI is quoting you; never prune it. site_status separates them; judge cited pages on impressions and branded-search growth, never clicks.

ANCHOR ROUTING: an exact-match commercial anchor is the most valuable link on the site and must point at the money page, never at a blog post. Measured: a blog cluster spent its "dermal fillers" and "Botox" anchors on other blog posts while the service pages sat at 19-26; the parent pillar with 26 inbound outranked its own children. Audit anchors with audit_post_links before assuming a service page is weak on merit.

BRANDED SHARE HONESTY: report organic reach net of brand searches. One site showed clicks +156% but 61% were people typing its name; non-branded rose 23 to 38. site_status splits this; a headline click number without the split overstates ranking progress.

LOCAL KEYWORD VOLUME IS NOT WHERE THE DEMAND IS: "medical weight loss irving tx" has ~10 typed searches/month, "botox irving tx" reports 0, while the same site collects thousands of GSC impressions on near-me and AI-surfaced variants. Judge local opportunity by warehouse impressions + map-pack presence, not by keyword-tool volume; and never commission content against "near me" pools, which resolve in the local pack (GBP category + review velocity), not organic.

PAGE FACTS FIRST (v0.75.0): page_facts(post_id) is the rendered-page ground truth (links incl. container-level with location, headings, meta, robots, canonical, images+alt, schema, word count) with explicit freshness and after-apply verification. Read it before any claim about what a page contains; do not derive presence/absence from get_elementor_widgets or audit_post_links alone. After any apply, its verification verdict (verified | FAILED | inconclusive_cache) is the answer to "did the write land", not the apply success flag.

ABSENCE NEEDS THE DOM (measured 2026-08-25): a parser can prove a link is present but can NEVER prove one is absent, because absence may only mean it cannot read that structure. The Elementor parser missed container-level links (<a class="e-con">) and reported a linked six-card grid as "links to nothing"; six harmful pendings were queued on that false gap. Before asserting any page LACKS a link, heading, image or schema, confirm against the rendered page: audit_post_links now returns rendered_cross_check with missed_by_parser, and render_probe is the verify path. Parser says missing != missing.

ACCESSIBILITY IS A LEGAL EXPOSURE, NOT A NICE-TO-HAVE (2026-08-25): ADA Title III lawsuits use WCAG 2.1 AA as the yardstick and healthcare sites are a preferred target; HHS Section 504 sets a hard WCAG 2.1 AA date (May 2027 / May 2028) for any provider taking federal healthcare funds. Measure with wcag_sweep (a real browser, pages scrolled before measuring: unscrolled runs fake contrast failures on lazy-loaded backgrounds) and accessibility_audit (rendered DOM, never post_content). The recurring real defects: empty citation anchors (an <a> wrapping only a non-breaking space, often with utm_source=chatgpt.com) which are nameless links - move the link onto the claim text, never delete it (the citation lint refuses); pages with no H1; theme-default link colour #cc3366 (3.7:1) because the kit never set link_normal_color; icon links with no accessible name; outline:none on custom inputs; autoplay carousels; iframes without title; embedded whole HTML documents inside HTML widgets. Site-wide colour fixes go through draft_update_kit_setting (one approval) instead of hundreds of widget edits; template and popup fixes go through widget edits once "Allow editing Theme Builder templates" is on, and are verified on a page the template covers. Never publish a "conforms to WCAG 2.1 AA" statement from an automated pass alone; "working toward" is the defensible wording.

THE WIN LOOP: winning a keyword is a campaign, not an audit. (1) keyword_targets set {query, owner_page} for every query the site must own; (2) each session keyword_targets report -> verdict per target; (3) stalled WITH rivals = consolidate (one owner, anchors, deindex zero-click rivals); stalled WITHOUT rivals = competitive gap: win_audit with the REAL top URLs (Ubersuggest MCP serp_analysis for the SERP, keyword_overview for volume; the plugin has no SERP API and must not proxy that sibling server) and execute its priority actions; hijacked = wrong own page ranks, reroute anchors; absorbed = reformat for citation; (4) act only through the pending queue with success_metrics set; (5) the next report shows movement. Attribute before adding a second change.
Page-style sampling: before adding new Elementor widgets, sample the page heading_sample + icon_box_sample so style matches. Do not impose defaults.

Wall-of-text guard (hard lint): a single text-editor widget over ~200 words with NO heading/list/table/image inside is refused at queue time. Route long content into the right Elementor widget by shape: enumeration → icon-list; Q&A → accordion item; steps → icon-box row; comparison → table.
Sentence length: under 25 words for at least 85% of sentences. Reading level: grade 7-9 for laypeople.
Pre-rewrite audit chain (run BEFORE proposing any meta or content change): canonical_audit, hreflang_audit (if multilingual), schema_parity_check, self_review_detection.
Post-rewrite measurement: helpful_content_score (per-post 0-100) tracks movement against Google's 28-question framework; site_quality_score aggregates domain-wide.

Answer-first + chunking: AI/Google match ~200-500 word CHUNKS, not whole pages. Open every section with its answer in 1-2 sentences; each section must stand alone (the "Island Test"); lead the page with a 40-60 word key-takeaway block. ~44% of LLM citations come from the first 30% of the text (directional).

Factual density beats formatting tricks: replace "studies show" with a named source + number + date + link (Princeton GEO: stats/quotes lift AI visibility up to ~40%, directional). Convert any comparison to a real HTML <table> (LLMs extract tables ~81% vs ~23% from prose, directional). Net-new rule: say something the top SERP results do not.

Local pack: primary GBP category is the #1 controllable lever (pick the narrowest accurate one). Review VELOCITY over 90 days beats total count; respond to 80%+ of reviews; NAP must be byte-consistent across directories. GBP Posts are NOT a ranking factor (Sterling Sky controlled study).

Off-page 2026: branded mentions (linked AND unlinked) correlate with AI visibility far more than raw backlinks (Ahrefs/Kalicube, directional). Describe each entity identically everywhere. Digital PR / HARO tied to a concrete linkable asset beats volume guest posts. A healthy profile is ~30-40% nofollow.

Do NOT waste time on (confirmed dead/debunked): llms.txt (Illyes/Mueller), schema-as-an-AI-trick, GBP-posts-for-ranking, geotagged photos, sitemap priority/changefreq tags, keyword density, repeating the transactional phrase across H2s, unedited bulk AI content. See the "Debunked" playbook section.

fit.hint: Active overlay "healthcare" only matches 13% of the site's vocabulary. The site talks about: irving, treatment, signs, pain, expert, room. Consider switching industry from Settings, or treat this overlay as partial guidance and verify each industry-specific recommendation against actual site content before proposing it.

business_mode.means: Freestanding ER: pages are TRANSACTIONAL/LOCAL. Above the fold = click-to-call + Walk In 24/7 + address/directions. EmergencyService schema. NOT appointment/booking language.

page_standard.doctrine: ONE page = ONE intent. Service/landing pages serve the conversion intent (transactional/local for ER, commercial/transactional for wellness); blog posts serve informational intent. Never mix. Informational depth ("what/why/causes/symptoms/when to go") belongs on a blog SPOKE that links inline to the service page — not on the service page itself.

layers.1_intent: Match the page to one intent; no informational sprawl on conversion pages.
layers.2_conversion: Message-matched H1 (echoes the query — #1 lever), answer-first (no buried lead), ONE primary CTA matched to business_mode, social proof at the decision point.
layers.3_trust: YMYL E-E-A-T: >=1 .gov/.edu/medical citation per 1000 words, mode-correct medical schema, NAP present, inverted-pyramid extractability, no cross-vertical vocabulary.

session_recap.bootstrap_hint: You are starting a new session on this site. FIRST run session_recap.preflight in order: whoami -> read the per-site design skill -> render_probe(post_id) before AND after any edit (verifies the LIVE rendered DOM / schema / alt / breadcrumb, since external curl is often WAF-blocked) -> list_pending_changes -> page_robustness_audit + win_audit. The session_recap pack above is your bootstrap context: rules + decisions + last 48 h of activity + the industry-tuned 2026 SEO playbook + the page_standard + business_mode. business_mode is the master lever: this site is "emergency" — read business_mode.means and judge every page that way (an ER page and a wellness page are judged OPPOSITELY above the fold). BEFORE building or optimizing ANY page/post, and AGAIN after, run page_robustness_audit(post_id) to clear the three-layer standard (intent -> conversion -> trust) and win_audit(post_id, query, competitor_urls) to beat competitors. These health sites are YMYL — be cautious and source every medical claim to .gov/.edu/medical consensus; never add a claim you cannot cite. The seo_playbook.top_rules combines universal + industry="healthcare" rules; READ seo_playbook.fit first and if status is "drift_detected"/"thin" verify each rule against real content and log gaps via update_site_memory_notes.
